shadcn_customizations.tables: Use compact paddings (py-2.5 px-3), mono font for weights & INR, keyboard row focus states, search-as-you-type instantly filtering multi-column data
shadcn_customizations.forms: Keyboard-first tab indexing, auto-focus next input on Enter, inline toggle buttons for SOLD vs HOLD per line item
shadcn_customizations.badges: Sharp contrast pill badges for HOLD (Amber), SOLD (Teal), SETTLED (Emerald), UNPRICED (Rose)
shadcn_customizations.cards: Subtle 1px warm sand border, no shadow heavy drop, high readability of numbers
shadcn_customizations.modal_dialogs: Dedicated Reversal confirmation dialog requiring explicit reason input with strong destructive visual alert

keyboard_driven_navigation.quick_entry: Search-as-you-type dropdowns for Party, Product, Godown, and Season

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select triggers, table rows, tab triggers, modal buttons) MUST include precise data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="btn-create-purchase-bill", data-testid="input-party-select", data-testid="kpi-physical-stock", data-testid="row-stock-ledger-1").
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: Text contrast ratio > 4.5:1 against light warm backgrounds. JetBrains Mono dark text for financial numbers.
testing_and_accessibility.hover_focus_states: Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-[#8B5A2B] hover:text-white). Focus ring in amber/espresso accent.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure strict dual-ledger core representation: Stock Ledger (Quantities in KG) and Party Ledger (Amounts in INR).
Ensure symmetric BUY/SELL HOLD-SOLD business model: Buy side can be SOLD (priced immediately) or HOLD (unpriced stored coffee). Sell side curing dispatches can be SOLD or HOLD.
Support full audit trail reversal action: No delete buttons; all reversals generate a counter entry with mandatory reason entry.
Build fast search-as-you-type filtering across all party master tables, stock ledgers, and transaction lists.

Render clear KPI summary cards on the main dashboard: Physical Stock KG, Unpriced HOLD Buy Exposure, Unpriced Dispatched Sell Exposure, Stock Cover Ratio, Outstanding Buy Advances, Outstanding Sell Advances, Net Payables & Receivables, and Daily Market Rate.
Use standard React .js or .jsx components consistent with shadcn UI provided in src/components/ui/.
Integrate sonner for instant keyboard shortcut notifications and success toasts.
